caption: A woman standing in the aisle of a bus holding the overhead rail sways backward as the bus pulls away from the stop.

sa.check: A woman stands in the aisle of a bus, holding an overhead rail.
The bus pulls away from a stop: it starts moving and the view outside begins to slide past.
She sways backward, toward the rear of the bus.
Her hand stays on the overhead rail through the sway.
The bus starts moving first and the sway follows.

pc.expect: She stands steady while the bus is at the stop; her sway begins as the bus starts moving and eases once it is running at a steady speed.
pc.fail: She sways while the bus is still standing at the stop; or she sways with no start of motion visible outside the windows; or she keeps swaying after the view outside has settled to a steady slide.

pc.expect: The sway carries her toward the rear of the bus, the rail arrests it, and she comes back upright.
pc.fail: She is thrown toward the front of the bus as it pulls away; or she leans sideways across the aisle while the bus goes straight; or she keeps toppling backward past the point where the rail holds her.

pc.expect: The overhead rail stays fixed and rigid where she grips it, and her feet stay on the floor of the aisle.
pc.fail: The rail bends or stretches as she pulls on it; or the rail comes away from the ceiling and she keeps hanging from it; or her feet leave the floor and she hangs in the air.

pc.expect: Other standing passengers and hanging straps lean or swing the same way at the same moment.
pc.fail: Another standing passenger sways toward the front while she sways backward; or the hanging straps stay still while she is plainly swaying; or they swing before the bus begins to move.
pc.precondition: Other standing passengers or hanging straps are visible in the aisle.

pc.expect: The passengers, the rail and the seats keep their number and shape, and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: Her hand passes through the rail; or she merges with a seat or with another passenger; or a limb detaches, vanishes or a second one appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Her clothing, the bus interior and the street seen through the windows stay consistent apart from the motion.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour; or the seat layout changes between frames; or the street outside jumps to a different place.

note: Inertia scene: the woman is kept because her body is what shows the sway. Her expression, posture and how hard the bus accelerates are not judged; only when and which way she moves.
